# Lumi Derm Aesthetics

> Advanced aesthetics and skin clinic in London Docklands, led by an experienced practitioner, offering consultation-led skin, laser, regenerative, body and beauty treatments.

Website: https://lumidermaesthetics.com/
Location: Unit 41 Skylines Village, Limeharbour, London E14 9TS
Phone: 07832839298
Email: info@lumidermaesthetics.co.uk

## Core Pages

- [Home](https://lumidermaesthetics.com/): overview of Lumi Derm Aesthetics, current offers, client reviews, FAQs, location and contact details.
- [Treatments and Prices](https://lumidermaesthetics.com/pages/services.html): full treatment menu, prices, consultation guidance and patch-test guidance.
- [Book Online](https://lumidermaesthetics.com/pages/booking.html): choose a treatment and open the secure Treatwell booking calendar.
- [About Lumi Derm](https://lumidermaesthetics.com/pages/about.html): clinic approach, practitioner background and treatment philosophy.
- [Policies](https://lumidermaesthetics.com/pages/policies.html): cancellation, deposits, patch tests, age restrictions and treatment safety terms.

## Treatment Areas

- Consultations and patch tests
- Laser hair removal and laser skin rejuvenation
- Laser treatment for thread veins and spider veins
- Electrolysis permanent hair removal and blemish removal
- PRP for face, body and hair loss
- Profhilo, polynucleotides, mesotherapy and skin boosters
- Facials, chemical peels, microneedling and exosomes
- Endospheres therapy, lymphatic drainage and body treatments
- Lash and brow treatments

## Booking Guidance

Advanced treatments may require a consultation or patch test before the treatment appointment. Use the booking page or contact the clinic if unsure which first-step appointment is required.

## Structured Data

The site includes JSON-LD for the clinic, FAQs, reviews, treatment categories, breadcrumbs and booking actions where relevant. The sitemap is available at https://lumidermaesthetics.com/sitemap.xml.
